post.description:
Checkout an existing order.

Supported payment methods:

    CASH
    UPI
    CARD
    CREDIT

CREDIT:
    Customer purchases now and pays later.
    The customer must have an approved credit account.

The checkout service is responsible for:
    - Inventory validation
    - Inventory reservation
    - Payment/credit processing
    - Order status update

Create a credit account for a customer at a shop.

Newly created accounts start with PENDING status.
The shopkeeper must approve the account before
CREDIT checkout can be used.

post.description:

After approval, the customer can use CREDIT checkout
